name: page-record
description: What a web page, or the part of it a selector names, looks like in each state of a scripted session, recorded deterministically in headless Chromium. Never cached.

verbs.name: capture
verbs.description: Run a page-steps file against its page and record each state: a settled screenshot, frames, the DOM without scripts, computed styles, and animations. Prints each settled screenshot path, one per line, or the recording with --json.

steps.description: A page-steps JSON file, as contracts/page-steps.schema.json defines it.

url.description: Record this URL instead of the steps file's url, such as a rebuild's preview.
